scope: independent root audit of the chosen split prime, additive projections, relative norms, subfield height, and stabilizer criterion for Item 342's Kummer lift

mathematical_audit.splitting: p is unramified and has residue order one modulo p-1, hence splits completely in Q(zeta_(p-1)) and the chosen prime has trivial decomposition group
mathematical_audit.additive_projection: modulo p the ring is a product of split coordinates; killing the selected coordinate alone does not force any nontrivial orbit sum or p-unit group-algebra projection to vanish
mathematical_audit.relative_norm: the product defining every relative norm contains the selected zero coordinate, so the gate is preserved, but another coordinate can also create an exact false positive
mathematical_audit.height: a subgroup of size h changes the per-embedding bound to B^h and the remaining degree to phi(p-1)/h; the resulting absolute norm and B^phi bound are exactly unchanged
mathematical_audit.stabilizer: the generated subfield degree is the Galois orbit size, so bounded-degree descent requires stabilizer size at least phi(p-1)/D; chosen-prime membership alone imposes no such equality
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: the theorem excludes only descent justified formally from the selected gate plus the Item-342 conjugate bound; special stabilizers, exceptional norm cancellation, extra full-collision conditions, and chosen-prime p-adic theorems remain open

EXACT_FINITE_ONLY: five declared and twelve independent group-ring controls
